status: pre-registered before implementation; amended with dev-set L1 evidence (A1-A3); decision thresholds pending acceptor confirmation

baseline.description: existing single-arm transport RRT-Connect with joint distance J and rotation soft cost R (default)
baseline.not_included: 0942d18 (upstream re-zero / new Home); conclusions are not extrapolated to it

stage.name: transport
stage.goal: stowed transport placement from the existing atlas, same candidates and filters as baseline

method.name: cartesian
method.branch_label: sign(q2, q4, q6) of the active arm, fixed per search
method.idle_arm: goals use the baseline idle-arm variants; the idle arm is joint-interpolated with transport progress s (A1)
method.ik: analytic bridge, unique solution for the given branch
tiers: RRT-Connect with Cartesian validity adapter (main, A2)
direct line to top-K same-branch goals (first attempt)
method.goal_snap: path end equals the selected same-branch atlas joint row, including its idle-arm variant
method.carriage_kinematics: closed-form translation of arm_carriage along the updown axis, verified against URDF FK (A3)
method.timing: transport segment is not joint-shortcut; a shortcut variant is reported as diagnostic B'

constraints.validity: same loaded GpuValidity including payload spheres
constraints.independent_audit: FCL mesh check on both methods

test_sets.dev_dual_non_regression: the 10 dual-arm rounds of WALL_SEQUENCE, baseline transport unchanged
notes: dev_single is right-arm only; holdout_single has 10 left and 10 right tasks, 8 top-suction and 12 side-suction
holdout_single runs only after the method configuration is frozen
known contact-IK failures are recorded but excluded from transport paired statistics

metrics.reporting: planning wall-clock and execution duration are reported separately; failures, timeouts and invalidated runs are kept

decision_rules_proposed.planning_time: transport stage median and P95 not worse than baseline by more than 10%, and within the 2 s budget
decision_rules_proposed.success: transport success rate not lower than baseline
decision_rules_proposed.quality: paired median extra box rotation on single-arm side tasks reduced by at least 30%, tool path/chord ratio not increased

decision_rule_clarifications.clarification: primary: paired (same task and seed) median change of the transport stage time; per-arm median and P95 reported as secondary; every search within the 2 s budget

amendment_policy: amendments use dev-set evidence only and are made before any holdout run

amendments.change: idle arm no longer fixed at the start value; goals use the baseline idle-arm variants
amendments.evidence: L1 dev (motion312-acceptance/l1-20261019): right12 and right07 have 0 valid goals with the idle arm equal to start

amendments.change: RRT tier becomes the main tier; direct line kept as first attempt
amendments.evidence: L1 dev: direct line succeeded on 1/5 tasks (right06 only), below the pre-registered 3/5 rule

amendments.change: closed-form carriage transform instead of per-step URDF FK
amendments.evidence: L1 dev: line checks took 28-73 ms, dominated by per-step yourdfpy FK; analytic IK solves in 17-20 us

amendments.change: search options tuned on dev and frozen as cartesian_options_frozen
amendments.evidence: motion312-acceptance/tune-20261020: 5 settings x 25 dev runs, all 25/25 successful; S3 gave search median 48 ms, P95 118 ms (default 50/207 ms)
